name: Release of the Sealed Knight!
main_effect:
[Main] By trashing 1 card with the [X Antibody] or [Chronicle] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When Digimon attack players, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your [Grademon] or Digimon with the [Chronicle] trait may digivolve into [Alphamon] or a level 6 or lower Digimon card with the [Chronicle] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
